purpose: Determine if the Repair14 H3 shift failure is already present on the initial z=1.5 surface because the nonzero quadratic source is incompatible with the frozen window-retarded dynamic initial conditions, or if a constraint-compatible algebraic initial state exists and the defect is generated only during propagation.
tests: reproduce the current Repair14 lapse+dust-density initial solve and measure initial shift/aniso residuals
solve dust-density+shift for N20,delta_varrho20 and independently monitor lapse/aniso
solve lapse+shift for N20,delta_varrho20 and independently monitor dust-density/aniso
form the row-scaled 3x2 system [lapse,dust-density,shift] and compute its least-squares residual
compute the left-null compatibility residual of the row-scaled 3x2 coefficient matrix against the row-scaled quadratic source target
report rank and singular values of the coefficient matrix and augmented matrix
repeat for every C, beta0 and m=1..40 on both Nt=64 and Nt=32 frozen Repair13 backgrounds

routing.INITIAL_SOURCE_INCOMPATIBILITY: row-scaled 3x2 least-squares or left-null compatibility residual exceeds 1e-6 on any material-source case and pairwise equation choices cannot close the third equation
routing.CURRENT_INITIAL_PARTITION_ONLY: a compatible N20,delta_varrho20 state exists at <=1e-6 but the current lapse+density initialization misses shift
routing.INITIAL_SURFACE_CLOSE_PROPAGATION_DEFECT: current lapse+density initialization itself closes shift <=1e-6 at the initial surface; Repair14 shift failure therefore first develops after initialization

explicit_nonchanges: no Lambda c1 or c2 edit
no window-retarded dynamic initial value or derivative edit
